ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "peace be upon you"? (1 mark)
   A. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   B. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟
   C. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   D. شُكْرًا

2. How is the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. maʿa s-salaama
   B. marhaban
   C. sabaahu l-khayr
   D. anaa bi-khayr

3. Which Arabic word means "good morning"? (1 mark)
   A. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   B. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   C. شُكْرًا
   D. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ

4. What does the Arabic word بِنْتٌ (bint) mean? (1 mark)
   A. son
   B. daughter
   C. mother's brother
   D. father's sister

5. What does the Arabic word مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) mean? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. cat
   C. chair
   D. room

6. What does the Arabic word الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. day
   C. week
   D. Sunday

7. How is the Arabic word صَدِيقٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. dawruka
   C. sadiiq
   D. kaʿka

8. What does the Arabic sentence أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I hear with my ear.
   B. I speak with my mouth.
   C. I see with my eye.
   D. I smell with my nose.

9. What does the Arabic word ادْخُلْ (udkhul) mean? (1 mark)
   A. listen
   B. open the door
   C. close your eyes
   D. come in

10. How is the Arabic word مُشْمِسٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jamiil
   B. jabal
   C. mushmis
   D. shajara

11. Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cloudy." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ
   C. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   D. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ

12. What does the Arabic word نَهْرٌ (nahr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. river
   B. hot
   C. mountain
   D. cold

13. What is the name of the Arabic letter ج? (1 mark)
   A. faa
   B. jiim
   C. dhaal
   D. qaaf

14. What is the name of the Arabic letter ل? (1 mark)
   A. yaa
   B. laam
   C. faa
   D. Daad

15. Which Arabic sentence means "My grandfather is old (big in age)." (1 mark)
   A. جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   B. أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   C. مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ
   D. أَخِي صَغِيرٌ

16. What does the Arabic word سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cup
   B. window
   C. door
   D. knife

17. Which Arabic sentence means "The house is big." (1 mark)
   A. الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ
   B. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ
   C. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   D. أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً

18. Which Arabic word means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. حَمَّامٌ
   B. كُوبٌ
   C. بَيْتٌ
   D. نَافِذَةٌ

19. Which sentence means 'On the table there is a cake'? (1 mark)
   A. fawqa t-taawilati baaluun
   B. hadiyya li-Aminata
   C. ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka
   D. haadhihi hafla

20. What does the Arabic sentence هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. On the table there is a cake.
   B. A gift for Amina.
   C. Above the table there is a balloon.
   D. This is a party.

21. When you read a picture, what should you look at first? (1 mark)
   A. Only the colours
   B. Only the corners
   C. Only the words
   D. The whole picture

22. Which Arabic word means "eggs"? (1 mark)
   A. جَزَرٌ
   B. ذُرَةٌ
   C. لَحْمٌ
   D. بَيْضٌ

23. When you time a friend reading, what matters most? (1 mark)
   A. Steady pace with correct words
   B. Being the fastest
   C. Ignoring punctuation
   D. Reading in a whisper

24. What does the Arabic sentence السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The juice is cold.
   B. The fish is delicious.
   C. Water is useful (good for you).
   D. I like food.

25. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا جِسْمِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. My body is strong.
   C. This is my body.
   D. I have two eyes.

26. What does the Arabic sentence لِي يَدَانِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. This is my body.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. My body is strong.

27. How is the Arabic word جَبَلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. jabal
   C. riih
   D. nahr

28. How is the Arabic word غَائِمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. haarr
   C. ghaa'im
   D. mushmis

29. What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. The key is in the cupboard.
   C. Do not play with the knife.
   D. The chair is at the door.

30. What does the Arabic sentence لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. Do not play with the knife.
   C. The key is in the cupboard.
   D. The chair is at the door.

31. Which Arabic word means "grandfather"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدٌّ
   B. جَدَّةٌ
   C. أُسْرَةٌ
   D. أَبٌ

32. Which Arabic sentence means "The table is small." (1 mark)
   A. النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ
   B. الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ
   C. الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ
   D. الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ

33. Which describing word matches the feminine noun taawila (table)? (1 mark)
   A. jadiid
   B. kabiir
   C. kabiira
   D. nadhiif

34. Which Arabic word means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. أَمْسِ
   B. السَّبْتُ
   C. الْأَحَدُ
   D. يَوْمٌ

35. Which Arabic sentence means "We dance." (1 mark)
   A. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ
   B. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   C. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   D. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ

36. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. I eat rice.
   C. Above the table there is a balloon.
   D. The banana is delicious.

37. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat rice.
   B. The water is clean.
   C. I drink tea.
   D. The banana is delicious.

38. Which sentence is a good ending for a paragraph about your room? (1 mark)
   A. uhibbu ghurfatii
   B. fii l-ghurfati sariir
   C. al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila
   D. haadhihi ghurfatii

39. What does it mean if a paragraph is coherent? (1 mark)
   A. It has only one word
   B. It is very long
   C. It is written in colour
   D. Its sentences fit together and make sense

40. What does the Arabic word تَحْتَ (taHta) mean? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. on
   C. beside
   D. behind

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how the voice should sound in a statement and in a question. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Write five words about weather and the environment in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

43. Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Write in Arabic sounds a question and an answer about bananas and give the meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Say what the words abii yaʿmalu and ummii tatbukhu mean, and name one thing each parent does. (4 marks) (4 marks)

46. Translate into English: anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah (2 marks)

47. Give three ways of taking care of your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: kayfa haaluki? (2 marks)

50. Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Explain how the weather affects our daily life. Give two examples. (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Describe three ways to work out the meaning of an unfamiliar word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: ashrabu sh-shaaya (2 marks)

54. Write three foods and two drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

55. Translate into English: al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana (2 marks)

56. Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Give two ways of keeping household items safe. (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: ʿindii hadiyya (2 marks)

59. Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

60. Give two tips for pronouncing Arabic greetings correctly. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

2. B — marhaban
   مَرْحَبًا is read marhaban and means hello.

3. B — صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ (sabaahu l-khayr) means good morning.

4. B — daughter
   بِنْتٌ (bint) means daughter.

5. A — lamp
   مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

6. D — Sunday
   الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

7. C — sadiiq
   صَدِيقٌ is read sadiiq and means friend.

8. B — I speak with my mouth.
   أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي (atakallamu bi-famii) means: I speak with my mouth.

9. D — come in
   ادْخُلْ (udkhul) means come in.

10. C — mushmis
   مُشْمِسٌ is read mushmis and means sunny.

11. B — الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

12. A — river
   نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

13. B — jiim
   The letter ج is called jiim.

14. B — laam
   The letter ل is called laam.

15. A — جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

16. D — knife
   سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) means knife.

17. A — الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ
   الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

18. C — بَيْتٌ
   بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

19. C — ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka
   ʿalaa means on, taawila is table and kaʿka is cake.

20. B — A gift for Amina.
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

21. D — The whole picture
   First look at the whole picture, then at the details.

22. D — بَيْضٌ
   بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

23. A — Steady pace with correct words
   Timing helps pace, but accuracy and smoothness matter most.

24. B — The fish is delicious.
   السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ (as-samaku ladhiidh) means: The fish is delicious.

25. C — This is my body.
   هَذَا جِسْمِي (haadhaa jismii) means: This is my body.

26. A — I have two hands.
   لِي يَدَانِ (lii yadaani) means: I have two hands.

27. B — jabal
   جَبَلٌ is read jabal and means mountain.

28. C — ghaa'im
   غَائِمٌ is read ghaa'im and means cloudy.

29. D — The chair is at the door.
   الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

30. B — Do not play with the knife.
   لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

31. A — جَدٌّ
   جَدٌّ (jadd) means grandfather.

32. B — الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ
   الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

33. C — kabiira
   A feminine noun takes the describing word ending in -a.

34. D — يَوْمٌ
   يَوْمٌ (yawm) means day.

35. C — نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

36. D — The banana is delicious.
   الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

37. C — I drink tea.
   أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ (ashrabu sh-shaaya) means: I drink tea.

38. A — uhibbu ghurfatii
   uhibbu ghurfatii (I like my room) gives a closing feeling.

39. D — Its sentences fit together and make sense
   A coherent paragraph has related sentences in a sensible order.

40. A — under
   تَحْتَ (taHta) means under.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? naʿam, uhibbu l-mawz. Do you like bananas? Yes, I like bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each meaning.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: abii yaʿmalu: My father works. ummii tatbukhu: My mother cooks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each translation and 1 mark for each role named.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am well, thanks be to God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well; play outdoors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: How are you? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid check.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Rain helps crops to grow; hot sun makes us look for shade; we choose our clothes by the weather.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the idea and 1 mark for each example.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use the sentence around the word; use a picture or a word you know; look it up in a dictionary or ask.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), samak (fish), mawz (bananas), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: The key is in the cupboard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep the key in a safe place such as the cupboard; keep knives out of reach of small children; keep lamps away from water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safe way.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

59. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the teacher first and copy; say long vowels for longer than short vowels; practise the throat sounds kh and ʿ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.
